summary: A member that trims locally deletes at most [trim] daily_claims claims a day (100,000 by default), so a large first cut drains over several days instead of one long trim

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change. A meta key, local_trim_day, counts the day's deletions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change: what a cut drops is the same, only when it is deleted changes.

compatibility.detail: A config that sets [trim] daily_claims is refused by an older build, which knows no such key; set it only once the member runs this build. Without it the default of 100,000 applies. A cut stopped at the cap stays trimming, which an older build finishes in one go.

downtime.detail: None. On a member that trims locally, a cut that drops more than the day's claims goes on the next day.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: an older build finishes a cut stopped at the cap in one trim. Before rolling back, remove [trim] daily_claims from the daemon's config if it is set: an older build refuses the key and will not start.
